items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Then behind that Claude Hopkins, the great piano player of our era - [INTERVIEWEE] That was spiritual.

ctx.x: ...Let me get this... Sitting here talking to you is a very - I don't know how to express these vibrations, but I'm sure on the tape the telephone which I would like to always remain in this tape, rang a couple of times and we stopped the tape just to answer the phone; the first time it was an old buddy who was in the Basie Band, Earl Warren, calling. Very spiritual. Then behind that Claude Hopkins, the great piano player of our era -
